industrial_bottlenecks.title: Industrial bottlenecks
industrial_bottlenecks.description: Manufacturers report that ageing plant and congested logistics are holding back output. The cabinet requests a clear priority.

options.title: Launch a modernisation programme
options.consequence: Costs treasury; raises GDP, productivity and construction capacity.

options.title: Industry must adapt privately
options.consequence: Preserves cash; modest stability loss.

housing_pressure.title: Housing pressure in growing cities
housing_pressure.description: Rapid urbanisation is raising rents and worsening living conditions in the largest regional centres.

options.title: Fund public housing
options.consequence: Costs treasury; improves living standards and reduces radicalism.

options.title: Ease planning rules
options.consequence: Cheaper and pro-growth, but less socially stabilising.

labour_dispute.title: National labour dispute
labour_dispute.description: A wage dispute is spreading across transport and heavy industry. Production is beginning to slow.

options.title: Broker a national settlement
options.consequence: Costs treasury; restores stability and living standards.

options.title: Order workers back
options.consequence: Preserves cash and output, but raises radicalism.

war_weariness.title: The war is being felt at home
war_weariness.description: Casualty lists have reached the regional papers, and the queues outside recruitment offices are shorter every week.

options.title: Address the nation honestly
options.consequence: Costs nothing but candour; steadies support without hiding the cost.

options.title: Raise separation allowances for families
options.consequence: Expensive, but buys real patience.

options.title: Tighten reporting from the front
options.consequence: Cheap and quick; corrosive if the war drags on.

budget_crisis.title: The treasury is running dry
budget_crisis.description: The finance ministry reports that current commitments cannot be met past the next quarter without a decision.

options.title: Raise taxes
options.consequence: Restores the budget; unpopular and mildly deflationary.

options.title: Cut the military budget
options.consequence: Frees money immediately at the cost of readiness.

options.title: Cut welfare and education
options.consequence: Balances the books; the social cost lands on the regions.

national_holiday.title: A day for celebration
national_holiday.description: The whole country seems to have taken the day off at once - stalls in every square, music down every street, strangers embracing strangers. It happens like this every so often, and nobody ever quite plans it.

options.title: Open the public purse
options.consequence: A modest cost; the mood is worth it.

options.title: Let the streets have their day
options.consequence: Costs nothing at all.

sporting_triumph.title: A nation watching one screen
sporting_triumph.description: For ninety minutes nobody in the country was arguing about anything else. The team has won, and for tonight at least, that is the only news that matters.

options.title: Throw them a parade
options.consequence: A small cost; a real lift in the national mood.

options.title: Let the win speak for itself
options.consequence: Free, and almost as good.

cultural_export.title: Everyone is watching us
cultural_export.description: A film made here, on a budget nobody expected to travel, is filling cinemas on three continents. Diplomats report it is, unexpectedly, easier to get a meeting this month.

options.title: Back the industry that made it
options.consequence: Costs treasury; lasting productivity and prestige.

options.title: Let the moment be its own reward
options.consequence: No cost; a brief lift.

scientific_prize.title: A prize comes home
scientific_prize.description: A researcher who has spent a career in an underfunded university department has just won the field's highest honour. The interview requests have not stopped since.

options.title: Fund the department properly at last
options.consequence: Costs treasury; literacy and productivity rise.

options.title: A medal and a photograph
options.consequence: Free; a small national lift.
